name: Inventory
title: Weight-only bag inventory, equipment, durability, and item-life ownership
summary: Personal inventory is an unlimited bag with equal-size entries; there is no grid or footprint cap, and weight is the only carrying limit. Comfortable capacity is 20 kg + Strength with a 200% hard limit; gold weighs zero. The home stash policy remains open.
scenarioNote: Отдельный проигранный сценарий в этот импорт не входил.

points.text: Every carried item, including equipped gear, contributes its weight; currency weighs zero. Equal-size UI entries do not consume variable grid footprints.
The initial armor, accessory, and hand-item weights are listed in 19; every specific base/tool/material/consumable still needs an explicit content weight.
Durability applies to hand equipment, worn armour, and gathering tools; jewellery and belts have none. Repair uses ordinary creation ingredients and no rare ingredient.
A broken item is unusable but remains present; it cannot be enchanted except for extraction from an unlocked modifier.
NPC current equipment is recoverable per item under the base-35% Luck formula; death does not automatically transfer a former character's carried/equipped inventory. Legacy Cache is separate.
The character has two universal hand slots and a shared necklace/amulet slot; full compatibility remains open.

gaps: Home-stash capacity/storage policy, full per-base item weights, equipment compatibility/requirements, wear/repair parameters, and Legacy Cache item eligibility remain open.
